content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text evaluates the Luke 2:48-49 challenge to a link and resolves it by an immediate qualification within the verse passage, which is the kind of pressed-witness collision K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse\": I weighed whether an immediate qualification inside Luke 2:48-49 is a permissible reading of the pressed passage, or whether it is a verse-by-verse resolution forbidden when the pressed witnesses are the pressing side's own chain read together.","why":"Because the judge resolves the pressed Luke 2:48-49 point by saying one clause immediately qualifies another, it uses verse-level qualification rather than the chain-against-chain footing K-C requires."}
